## What it does

When an agent writes code that opens a radio image, this skill makes it:

- drop degenerate `FREQ` and `STOKES` axes before using the WCS;
- read the beam from the header (`BMAJ`, `BMIN`, `BPA`) or from a beam table, and stop if it is missing;
- convert Jy/beam to Jy using the beam area in pixels, with `astropy.units` throughout;
- print the units of every quantity it reports.

## How to check the result

Measure a source whose flux is known (a catalogue value or a point source in a simulated image) and compare.
